review_candidates.title: Certified Nursing Assistant CNA
review_candidates.description: Certified Nursing Assistant - CNA Majestic Care of Columbus is looking for a Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) to join our team's mission and believe in our core values! Our mission: Through the hearts of our Care Team Members, we provide excellent healthcare to those we serve. Our Core Values... L - Listening E - Empathy A - Accountability D - Decisiveness This is how we create a culture to LEAD with Love. Position Overview: The CNA is a member of the community nursing team whose responsibility is to assist professional nursing personnel by delivering direct hands-on nursing care to ambulatory and non-ambulatory residents on a daily basis. The CNA is also responsible for assisting the residents to achieve the highest level of functioning while living as normal a lifestyle as possible. Key Responsibilities: To perform or assist the resident with completing Activities of Daily Living (ADL). Respond to residents call lights to provide maximum comfort, safety and privacy. Transport residents by ambulation or by wheelchair to areas of community (dining room, lobby and activities). Report any significant findings/observations to nurse immediately. Assist residents on admission, transfer and discharge to make a smooth transition. Responsible for the safekeeping of residents’ personal possessions. Keep resident rooms neat and safe. Follow proper infection control techniques Respect the rights of each resident, particularly privacy and confidentiality. Re-teach resident to perform ADL skills. Provide restorative care to prevent pressure sores, contractures, and complications. Participate in Continuous Quality Improvement and ensures follow-up occurs. Converse with resident and family; assist them on adjustment to the community. Ensure adequate hydration and nutrition of resident; report deviations from norm to the Charge Nurse promptly. Perform blood pressure, pulse, respirations, intake/output and weights accurately. Qualifications: Certified and state tested as a Certified Nursing Assistant in the state employed; certificate must be active, valid, and in good standing. Majestic Difference Benefits: Quarterly Pay Increase Daily Pay Company-Paid Life Insurance Telehealth Services Double Pay on Holidays Care Team Member Relief Fund Join the Majestic Care team where compassion meets excellence! #LoMed

This role assists residents with activities of daily living (ADLs), ensures a safe and comfortable environment, and supports licensed nursing staff in delivering individualized care in accordance with regulatory requirements and facility policies. Join us with an attractive benefits offering: Competitive pay Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401K with matching funds Life Insurance Employee discounts Tuition Reimbursement Student Loan Reimbursement RESPONSIBILITIES: The essential functions of this position include the following. This list is not intended to be exclusive or exhaustive. There may be additional essential functions based on the unique nature of the position or environment.        Provide direct resident care, including assistance with bathing, grooming, dressing, toileting, incontinent care as applicable, oral hygiene and feeding.   Measure and record vital signs, weight, percentage of meal consumed intake/output as directed.   Assist residents with mobility, transfers, and position using proper body mechanics and lift equipment as applicable.   Respond promptly to call lights, resident needs, and changes in condition; report observations to licensed nursing staff.   Support residents’ independence and dignity, while ensuring safety and comfort   Maintain accurate and timely documentation and in accordance with facility procedures   Follow infection control, safety, and universal precaution guidelines at all times.   Provide emotional support and companionship to residents, fostering a positive living environment   Maintains a clean, safe and comfortable environment   Provides postmortem care   Make routine rounds on each assigned resident every two hours.   Provides skin care and observes residents’ skin when giving care and reports changes to licensed nurse.   Modifies own behavior in response to residents’ behaviors.   Is aware of developmental tasks associated with the aging process.   Contributes to the residents’ assessment (MDS/CAA’s) and the plan of care.   Provides nursing rehabilitation/restorative nursing services   Promote residents’ ability to adapt and adjust to living as independently as possible.   Assists the resident in self-care according to the resident’s abilities.   Assists the residents in the use of assistive devices for transferring, walking and mobility, dressing and grooming, eating and swallowing.   Maintains range of motion, proper turning and positioning in bed and chair.   Assists with bowel and bladder retraining.   Instructs the resident on the care and use of prosthetic and orthotic devices.   Incorporates training and skill practice activities, which include repetition, physical or verbal cueing, and task segmentation.   Cares for residents with Dementia   Knows how to respond to residents’ behaviors.   Allows residents to make personal choices.   Provides and reinforces other behavior consistent with residents’ dignity.   Uses the resident’s families as a source of emotional support for the resident.   Demonstrates a basic understanding of behavior and functional symptoms associated with dementia by providing interventions and treatments to help reduce these symptoms.   Uses modification in the presentation of activities of daily living to maintain and maximize resident functions.   Uses effective intervention techniques to address behavioral concerns.   Assists with transporting residents to activities.   Demonstrates effective communication techniques for residents with dementia.   Provides non-resident care including but not limited to:   Wash wheelchairs.   Cleaning soiled utility areas.   Cleaning shower and whirlpool rooms.   Cleaning kitchen areas on the nursing unit.   Performs other duties assigned.   QUALIFICATIONS     Education and/or Experience:       High School Graduate/GED    Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:       Must be a Certified Nursing Assistant in good standing with the certification board or is a graduate of a state approved nursing assistant training program and passed a state approved competency examination (written and skills) within 120 days of employment; name entered into state nurse aide registry.   Minimum Qualifications:     Computer skills are required.   Meets all state and federal criminal background check requirements. review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Columbia, Maryland, Synergy ECP is a leading provider of cybersecurity, software and systems engineering and IT services to the U.S. intelligence and defense communities. The company leverages its expertise in data transport solutions, software and systems engineering, and other solutions to deliver critical and innovative capabilities to high-level decision makers that enhance our nation’s security. In an ultra-competitive environment, Synergy ECP has thrived by adhering to our name, making sure excellence is displayed by our Employees, to our Customers and by Improving Performance (ECP). It’s what sets us apart, enabling us to be an autonomous yet agile business that delivers huge results—showing we’re ready to meet our customers’ evolving demands. Synergy ECP has earned a client list that includes numerous Fortune 100 companies, in addition to multiple branches of the US government and military services. Position Overview We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient Senior DevOps Engineer to play an integral role in our team, focusing on deploying infrastructure and engineering workflows and processes to support enterprise AI rollouts. This position requires deep expertise in DevOps principles, including containerization, CI/CD pipeline architecture, and AI model lifecycle management. The ideal candidate will be adept at ensuring robust, scalable, and efficient deployment and maintenance of AI applications at an enterprise scale. What You'll Be Doing Design, implement, and maintain robust infrastructure for enterprise AI applications in cloud environments (AWS, Microsoft Azure) Develop and optimize engineering workflows and processes to support AI model development, deployment, and maintenance. Architect and manage CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and continuous delivery of AI models and applications. Implement and manage containerization solutions using technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. Ensure efficient AI model lifecycle management, including versioning, monitoring, and scaling. Collaborate with AI/ML engineers and data scientists to streamline deployment processes and optimize resource utilization. Oversee system performance, security, and scalability of AI infrastructure. Continuously research and implement new DevOps tools and practices to enhance efficiency. Required Experience B.S. in a relevant technical field with 12 years of experience, or M.S. in a relevant technical field with 10 years of experience. Advanced proficiency in DevOps principles and practices. Demonstrated expertise in containerization using Docker and Kubernetes. Proven experience in architecting and managing CI/CD pipelines. Extensive experience with AI model lifecycle management and maintenance. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure) for infrastructure deployment and management. Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack). Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable engineering solutions. TS/SCI with CI Poly. review_candidates.title: U.S. Marketplace Growth Marketer
review_candidates.description: About the job You'll help grow Korean consumer brands across major U.S. marketplaces by combining content, advertising, and performance data to figure out what actually drives growth. Seongsu, Seoul · In-person · Full-time ABOUT ORBITERS Orbiters is an AI-powered brand operating group. We grow standout Korean consumer brands in the U.S. market on Amazon, Target Plus, Ulta Beauty, Macy's, TikTok Shop, and Faire. We also run our own U.S. store, Onzenna. WHAT YOU'LL DO Marketplace growth here isn't just about keeping products listed or campaigns running. You'll look at how customers discover, evaluate, and buy our products, then use content, advertising, and performance data to improve what happens next. Drive growth across major U.S. marketplace channels including Amazon, Macy's, and Ulta Beauty. Plan and produce video content, including Amazon Sponsored Brand Video (SBV), designed to improve product discovery and conversion. Analyze content performance across views, engagement, CTR, conversion, and sales, then scale the formats and ideas that work. Understand and manage PPC campaigns including Amazon Sponsored Products (SP), continuously improving keywords, bids, budgets, and ROAS. Help grow our brands' Instagram accounts and plan content that resonates with U.S. consumers. Plan and execute marketplace product content, promotions, advertising, and campaigns. Test new messaging, creative concepts, and product positioning based on U.S. customer response and performance data. Work closely with our content, performance marketing, and tech teams to turn insights into experiments and experiments into repeatable growth. YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF you think clearly, learn fast, and finish what you start, whatever your background. you're interested in understanding why one product, ad, or piece of content performs better than another. you naturally notice strong creative, messaging, and product positioning. you work in English at a professional level and are comfortable understanding U.S. consumers and marketplace content. you're comfortable with numbers and want to understand what happened after a campaign or piece of content went live. you're interested in performance marketing and want to learn how PPC, content, pricing, promotions, and conversion work together. you aren't intimidated by AI tools, and you'd rather improve the workflow than repeat the same manual task forever. you're early in your career: 0-3 years of work experience. A marketing degree, Amazon experience, or prior marketplace experience is not the test. Strong judgment, analytical thinking, communication, and curiosity matter more. GOOD TO KNOW You'd work in a lean organization with frequent interaction with C-levels. You'll work closely with our social content, performance marketing, marketplace, and tech teams. You'll start by working across our U.S. marketplace brands, with a particular focus on Amazon growth, content, and advertising, and have room to take on broader growth projects as your strengths show. This isn't a role where you just monitor dashboards or maintain listings. We want you to understand why growth happened, what we should test next, and how to turn what works into a repeatable system. WHAT WE OFFER Work that reaches real U.S. customers. The content, campaigns, and marketplace decisions you make can directly influence what customers see and buy across Amazon, Macy's, Ulta Beauty, Instagram, and other channels. Room to build. AI carries the routine work here, and people make the calls. Direct feedback loops. We run the brands, the ads, the marketplace channels, and the store, so you can see how a change in creative, keywords, positioning, or promotion translates into actual performance. A weekly lunch and snack allowance on a corporate card, which as a rule each of us carries for business use. A performance bonus tied to your results, quarterly check-ins, and a formal review every six months with compensation and stock options on the table. A casual dress code. THE BASICS This is a full-time, in-person role at our office in Seongsu, Seoul, which runs in Korean and English. We offer competitive compensation, set with your experience and background in mind. If you're still in school, ask us about the intern track. You need to be legally eligible to work full-time in Korea already, through citizenship, permanent residence, or a visa that allows it. We aren't able to sponsor visas for applicants from outside Korea. HOW WE HIRE FOR THIS ROLE This role is open on a rolling basis. When we meet the right person, we move ahead instead of waiting for a set date. HOW TO APPLY Easy Apply is all we need and your resume is enough. If you've worked on marketplace growth, paid advertising, social media, video content, or performance analysis, links or examples are welcome. No cover letter is needed. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT We read every application, and if it looks like a match, we'll reach out for a short conversation. https://orbiters.co.kr/
